series.name: Generic DC inverter (non-CSDC-labeled videos + blogs)
series.notes: Generic 'Changhong Ruba DC inverter' videos + mashallah blog + hvacdirectplus transcripts. F0 dual meaning (outdoor fan vs indoor fan by PCB) noted per-code. May overlap CSDC series digits — separate file.

title.en: F0 indoor fan motor no feedback
title.ur: F0 andar ke fan motor ka feedback nahi

meaning.en: Indoor fan motor faulty, jammed, or feedback missing so unit shows F0.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor kharab, jam hua ya feedback ghayab hai — is liye unit F0 dikhata hai.

causes.ur: Blower jam hua ya koi ajnabi cheez phansi hui

causes.en: Fan motor open winding or loose connector
causes.ur: Fan motor ki winding khuli ya connector dhila
Andar ke PCB ka fan driver wala hissa

solutions.en: Open indoor cover (power off) and free blower
solutions.ur: Power off karke indoor cover kholein aur blower azaad karein

solutions.en: Check connector seating and replace motor if dead
solutions.ur: Connector ki baith jaan lein; motor mar chuka ho to badal dein

solutions.en: If motor good, service indoor PCB driver
solutions.ur: Agar motor theek ho to indoor PCB driver service karein

source.title: Changhong Ruba Dc Inverter Ac f0 Error code | f2 error code

notes.en: See also dual F0 mapping under CSDC block (QarSES6LQDM).
notes.ur: CSDC block ke neeche wale dual F0 mapping bhi dekhein (QarSES6LQDM).

title.ur: F1 andar ke kamre ka temperature sensor

meaning.ur: Andar ke kamre ka temperature sensor kharab hai (open/short/ganda).

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate mains power, then unplug the indoor room sensor before probing anything.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle mains band karke supply alag karein, phir kuch bhi check karne se pehle room sensor ka plug nikal dein.

solutions.en: Measure the sensor resistance with a multimeter at room temperature; if it reads open or shorted, replace the sensor.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se kamre ke temperature par sensor ki resistance naapein; open ya short nikle to sensor badal dein.

solutions.en: Clean or dry a wet/dirty sensor bulb and repair any broken harness wire, then refit the sensor and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: Gila ya ganda sensor bulb saaf kar ke sookha karein aur tooti hui harness wire theek karein, phir sensor dobara lagayein aur dekh lein ke code clear ho gaya.

title.ur: F2 bahar ka temperature sensor open/short

meaning.en: Outdoor temperature sensor faulty, open, or short-circuited.
meaning.ur: Outdoor temperature sensor kharab, khula ya short ho chuka hai.

causes.ur: Outdoor sensor ki taar nuksaan de chuki hai
Bahar ke PCB ka input kharab

solutions.ur: Outdoor khol kar sensor badal dein

solutions.en: If code remains, check outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Agar code wahi rahe to outdoor PCB check karein

title.ur: F4 andar ke fan motor ka fault (DC inverter list)

meaning.en: Mashallah list: F4 Indoor Fan Motor Fault (also lists a second F4 as outdoor section line sensor).
meaning.ur: Mashallah list: F4 indoor fan motor fault (is list mein aik doosra F4 outdoor section ke line sensor ka bhi hai).

causes.en: Alternate: outdoor section line temperature sensor
causes.ur: Doosra matlab: bahar ke section ki line ka temperature sensor

solutions.en: Confirm which F4 definition matches symptoms
solutions.ur: Alamaat ke mutabiq tasdeeq karein ke in par kaun si F4 definition lagti hai

solutions.en: Test indoor fan first if unit fan silent
solutions.ur: Agar unit ka fan khamosh ho to pehle indoor fan test karein

meaning.en: Indoor and outdoor not communicating (serial link).
meaning.ur: Andar aur bahar baat nahi kar rahe (serial link).

causes.ur: Bahar ke PCB ka fuse/board jal gaya

causes.en: Indoor supply to outdoor not switching
causes.ur: Indoor se outdoor ki supply switch nahi ho rahi

solutions.en: Trace indoor-to-outdoor power and signal wires
solutions.ur: Indoor se outdoor jane wali power aur signal taarein trace karein

solutions.en: Replace fuse/board as required after isolation

title.en: R1 outdoor kit low voltage fault
title.ur: R1 bahar ke kit ka low voltage fault

meaning.en: Outdoor kit shows low voltage fault (R1) on the board during troubleshooting.
meaning.ur: Troubleshooting ke dauran board par outdoor kit ka low voltage fault (R1) dikha gaya hai.

causes.ur: Outdoor kit ki supply threshold se kam
Kit control board ka sensing masla

solutions.ur: Bahar ke kit ki input voltage naapein

solutions.en: Repair/replace outdoor kit board if supply OK
solutions.ur: Supply theek ho to outdoor kit board marammat karein ya badal dein
